review.notes:
Kinetempo is an interval timer for physiotherapy exercises (isometric holds, lift-hold-release reps, slides, plain countdowns).

PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE. People doing physiotherapy / post-operative rehab at home, and the physiotherapists who prescribe the exercises. The problem: rehab protocols are timed ("hold 8 s, relax 4 s, 25 times"), and a phone timer stops or requires tapping when the screen locks while the user is lying down. Kinetempo plays a distinct sound for every step, keeps running with the screen locked, and shows the step and countdown on the Lock Screen.

BACKGROUND AUDIO. The app uses the audio background mode because its core feature is playing audible cues while the screen is locked: a beep at every step change (different sounds per step type) and ticks during the last 3 seconds of a hold. Between cues a silent keep-alive stream keeps the audio session active so the session is not interrupted. The service starts only when the user presses Start and ends with the session.

TYPICAL USE. The app is used with the screen on (keep-awake is enabled in the player): the schematic figure, the big countdown and the step colours guide the tempo. When the phone is locked, the sound cues are the guide. A Live Activity shows the time left in the session and the next steps (native countdowns); it is deliberately minimal because iOS limits background updates, and it can be turned off in Settings.

HOW TO TEST (2 minutes, no account or credentials needed):
1. Exercises -> "Quad isometrics" -> Play -> Start.
2. Lock the device. Beeps continue every 8 s (squeeze) / 4 s (relax); the Live Activity shows the step and countdown.
3. Unlock: the player shows the current step; leaving the player keeps a banner with pause/stop on top of every screen.
4. Exercises -> "+" asks whether to build the exercise by hand or with an AI assistant. By hand: pick a preset (isometric, lift-hold-release, dynamic, timer) and one of the built-in schematic animations. The assistant buttons open the user's own chat app with a text request, or copy that request to the clipboard; the app sends nothing to them and receives nothing back automatically - the user pastes the answer in themselves.
5. Library tab -> "Knee rehab block" -> Import -> Programs -> Play runs several exercises with rests in between.
6. Share -> link / QR / file exports a program; Import (download icon) reads one back.
7. Share -> "Send to the catalog" submits a program for review (see USER CONTENT). It publishes nothing.

EXTERNAL SERVICES. None for core functionality. No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no payments. The app calls no AI service: the "create with an assistant" buttons only open the user's own chat app with a prepared request, or copy that request to the clipboard, and the user brings the answer back by hand.

The app makes exactly two kinds of network request, both to endpoints we control:
(a) HTTPS GET of a public JSON catalog on GitHub Pages (https://selic.github.io/kinetempo-catalog/catalog/index.json) for the Library tab. The app works fully offline without it.
(b) HTTPS POST to https://submit-kinetempo.defency.net, only when the user chooses to submit their own program to the public catalog and confirms a dialog. Never automatic, never in the background.

YouTube links attached to an exercise open in the YouTube app / browser. All other user data stays on the device.

USER CONTENT. Users create exercises for themselves and can share them peer-to-peer by link, QR or file (the data is encoded in the link/file; nothing is uploaded to us). There is no feed, no comments, no messaging, no profiles, and no way to see another user's content inside the app.

A user may submit their own program to the public catalog. This is a moderated submission, not publishing. The app posts the program to our endpoint, which opens a pull request on github.com/selic/kinetempo-catalog. The program is not visible to anyone in the app unless a maintainer reads it and merges it; automated checks verify the file format only. Before sending, the user confirms a dialog stating that acceptance makes the program public, that it cannot be withdrawn afterwards, and that nobody clinical reviews it. Submissions are rate limited per address. Merged entries appear in the Library attributed to "Community" and flagged as unverified. No user can publish to the catalog; only the repository maintainers can.

REGIONS. The app functions identically in all regions; the interface is localized to English, Russian and Romanian.

REGULATED INDUSTRY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL. Kinetempo is a timer, not a medical device: it gives no diagnosis or treatment advice and does not access Health data. Catalog programs are labelled as published by their authors and not medical advice; the Terms of Use say the same. All code, sounds (synthesized), animations (drawn in code) and texts are our own; no third-party protected material is included.

Permissions are requested only when used: Photos (attach a video from the gallery), Camera (scan a shared QR code).

en-US.name: Kinetempo
en-US.subtitle: Physio exercise timer
en-US.promotionalText: Follow the moving figure with the app open; when the phone is locked, the sound cues keep going.
en-US.description:
Kinetempo times your physiotherapy exercises so you can focus on the movement, not the phone.

• Steps, not just seconds — squeeze, lift, hold, release, move, rest. Every step has its own sound and colour, with ticks on the last three seconds.
• Follow the figure — the built-in schematic figure moves in time with the timer and the screen stays on while you train; the big countdown and colours show every step.
• Sound keeps going when locked — lock the phone and every step change is still a distinct beep, with ticks before it ends. The Lock Screen shows the time left and the next steps.
• Programs — combine exercises into a block with rests between them, e.g. quad sets → straight-leg raises → heel slides → heel prop.
• Presets — isometric hold, lift-hold-release, dynamic reps, plain countdown, or build your own step sequence.
• Video and animation — attach a YouTube link or a video from your gallery, a Lottie animation, or use the built-in schematic figures that move in time with the timer.
• Share — send a program by link, QR code or file. Import what your physiotherapist sends you.
• Library — a public catalog of programs published by clinics and physiotherapists, reviewed on GitHub.
• Private — everything stays on your phone. No account, no tracking.

Kinetempo is a timer, not a medical device. Follow your clinician's instructions.

ru.name: Kinetempo
ru.subtitle: Таймер упражнений ЛФК
ru.promotionalText: С открытым приложением — следите за движущейся фигурой; при заблокированном телефоне — по звуку.
ru.description:
Kinetempo отсчитывает время упражнений ЛФК, чтобы вы думали о движении, а не о телефоне.

• Шаги, а не просто секунды — напрячь, поднять, задержать, опустить, движение, отдых. У каждого шага свой звук и цвет, последние три секунды — тики.
• Следите за фигурой — встроенная схематичная фигура двигается в такт таймеру, экран не гаснет во время занятия; крупный отсчёт и цвет показывают каждый шаг.
• Звук не останавливается при блокировке — заблокируйте телефон, и каждая смена шага останется отдельным сигналом с тиками перед концом. На экране блокировки — остаток сессии и следующие шаги.
• Комплексы — собирайте упражнения в блок с отдыхом между ними.
• Пресеты — изометрия, поднять‑задержать‑опустить, динамика, простой таймер или своя последовательность шагов.
• Видео и анимации — ссылка на YouTube, видео из галереи, Lottie‑анимация или встроенные схематичные фигуры, движущиеся в такт таймеру.
• Делитесь — ссылкой, QR‑кодом или файлом. Импортируйте то, что прислал физиотерапевт.
• Библиотека — публичный каталог программ от клиник и физиотерапевтов.
• Приватность — всё хранится на телефоне. Без аккаунта и слежки.

Kinetempo — таймер, а не медицинское устройство. Следуйте указаниям своего врача.

ro.name: Kinetempo
ro.subtitle: Cronometru kinetoterapie
ro.promotionalText: Cu aplicația deschisă urmărești figura în mișcare; cu telefonul blocat, semnalele sonore continuă.
ro.description:
Kinetempo cronometrează exercițiile de kinetoterapie, ca să te concentrezi pe mișcare, nu pe telefon.

• Pași, nu doar secunde — contractă, ridică, menține, coboară, mișcare, pauză. Fiecare pas are sunetul și culoarea lui, cu ticuri în ultimele trei secunde.
• Urmărește figura — figura schematică integrată se mișcă în ritmul cronometrului, iar ecranul rămâne aprins în timpul exercițiului; numărătoarea mare și culorile arată fiecare pas.
• Sunetul continuă cu ecranul blocat — fiecare schimbare de pas rămâne un semnal distinct, cu ticuri înainte de final. Ecranul de blocare arată timpul rămas și pașii următori.
• Programe — combină exercițiile într-un bloc cu pauze între ele.
• Presetări — izometrie, ridică‑menține‑coboară, repetări dinamice, cronometru simplu sau propria secvență de pași.
• Video și animații — link YouTube, video din galerie, animație Lottie sau figurile schematice integrate, sincronizate cu cronometrul.
• Distribuie — prin link, cod QR sau fișier. Importă ce îți trimite kinetoterapeutul.
• Bibliotecă — catalog public de programe publicate de clinici și kinetoterapeuți.
• Confidențial — totul rămâne pe telefon. Fără cont, fără urmărire.

Kinetempo este un cronometru, nu un dispozitiv medical. Urmează indicațiile medicului.
